about: Classical award winners and Grammy nominations, compiled from the public lists named in `sources` (facts only: award, year, composer, work, performers; no review text). Grammy years are ceremony years (the release is one to two years earlier); Gramophone and Diapason years are award years. Rebuilt by the parser described in docs/accolades.md; entry ids are stable hashes, so user decisions survive a rebuild.
